routing_observation_model.domain_route: observational-only in the 12-case minimum parity subset
routing_observation_model.composed_transverse_routes: required routes plus only explicitly allowed additional routes
routing_observation_model.maintainer_normalization: agent-governance-source-maintainer is separated from transverse routing regardless of whether a host emitted it in a primary or composed slot

codex.coordinator_policy: one D060 coordinator for the E2 work unit
codex.trial_context_policy: clean-isolated-context-per-trial; concrete child/thread/session mechanics are Executor-owned
codex.cli_identity_requirement: none; codex CLI version is execution-mechanics metadata only and is not the Codex Desktop host identity

evidence_reuse_policy.freeze_c_codex_trials: eligible for deterministic rescore without provider/model rerun when the original record preserves enough raw routing information to apply Freeze D normalization without consulting the expected oracle
evidence_reuse_policy.historical_records: immutable; rescoring is persisted separately and never rewrites Freeze C evidence
